bio: Set just two minutes walk from Primrose Hill Park, enjoy Afternoon Tea at Sweet Things Bakery either inside or outside. An inclusive atmosphere, it is child and dog friendly.  The tea is made up of our fresh, homemade and award winning items which include: Smoked salmon and cream cheese/avocado and roasted peppers brioche rolls, award winning scones with clotted cream and homemade jam, cupcakes, banana bread, award winning brownies, strawberries dipped in Belgian chocolate and unlimited loose leaf tea.  There are 7 tables inside and 13 tables outside which can all be joined together to accommodate larger sized groups.  As everything is made fresh and to order, 24 hours notice is required for booking and we can also amend the menu for GF/Vegan/Vegetarian requests. The turn time is 1.5 hours, with bookings in 30 minute increments.
